file.create.notes: Create HTML, SVG, Markdown, JSON, source, or asset files locally.

document.inspect.notes: Inspect local images, PDFs, SVG, design tokens, and source files.

canvas.execute.notes: The local application or self-contained HTML is the editable design artifact.

render.capture.notes: Render localhost or a local file in Chromium and capture screenshots.

asset.import.notes: Copy or embed local assets; do not upload them.

asset.export.notes: Export local SVG, PNG, PDF, HTML, or source artifacts.

token.read.notes: Read CSS variables, token JSON, themes, and project conventions.

token.write.notes: Write local CSS variables or token files.

component.read.notes: Inspect source components and Storybook stories.

component.write.notes: Create or update source components and stories.

component.map.notes: Use component imports, Storybook stories, and a local mapping document.

diagram.create.notes: Create Mermaid, SVG, or self-contained HTML locally.

whiteboard.edit.notes: Create .excalidraw, SVG, or self-contained HTML locally.

slides.edit.notes: Create Marp Markdown or self-contained HTML slides locally.

motion.read.notes: Inspect local CSS, JavaScript, video, or motion specifications.

motion.write.notes: Implement motion in local application source.
